## Release target

- [ ] `main`, deploys `analytics.eic.agency`
- [ ] `marketing-production`, deploys `eic.agency`

## Change controls

- [ ] This PR starts from the latest target branch.
- [ ] The change is limited to the intended site and scope.
- [ ] Build, tests, and targeted QA were completed and results are documented below.
- [ ] The Vercel preview was reviewed when applicable.
- [ ] No production deployment, manual Vercel promotion, alias reassignment, or `vercel --prod` command was used.
- [ ] Existing live routes and assets that must be preserved were checked.

## Verification evidence

Describe the checks performed, affected routes, and any remaining risk.

## Production release

Only Dustin merges or bypasses production requirements after review. Merging the approved PR into the correct production branch is the release mechanism.
